about.label: 01 / About
about.heading: Your ideas on screen.
about.text_1: Full-stack developer based in Brussels, I work on projects that combine solid business logic with polished interfaces. From B2B marketplaces to mobile apps and ticketing systems — I love challenges that require as much thinking as coding.
about.text_2: My stack revolves around Next.js, React and TypeScript, with a particular focus on performance and user experience. I also integrate Google Ads & SEO strategies to create real business solutions, not just a website.

about.step1_text: We start by understanding your context, constraints and what you really want to achieve. No solution before knowing the problem.
about.step2_text: Wireframes, technical choices, data structure. I build a solid foundation before writing a single line of code.
about.step3_text: Regular deliveries, continuous feedback. You see the product take shape each sprint, with no bad surprises.
about.step4_text: Clean deployment, clear docs, post-launch support. I don't disappear after delivery.
